Agent Name: VideoContentAnalysis_Expert  
Step Number: 1  
Reason for Mistake: The first error was identifying “The Secret Life of Plankton” as the first National Geographic short on YouTube. The evidence shown by the search result only points to a National Geographic “Short Film Showcase” playlist, not that specific video as the first-ever short. Since the foundation of the answer depended on this unsupported identification, the later claim that #9 was Pacific Bluefin Tuna is not reliably established.
